articles.headline: Inside the stunning 72-hour Lakers sale -- and the uncertainty that still looms
articles.description: Three days of secret talks resulted in Mark Walter flipping the Lakers -- and reignited yet another round of bickering among the six Buss siblings.

images.name: Lakers [1296x729]
images.caption: The summer sale of the Lakers sent shockwaves across the sports world, and sent the organization into chaos -- again.
images.credit: AP Photo, Getty Images, Imagn Images

images.name: Shelburne Lakers sale -- photo2 [576x324]
images.caption: When Jeanie Buss sold the Lakers to Walter, she showed Doncic paperwork that assured him that she would still be in charge of his basketball future. Ten months later, that promise is no longer certain.

images.name: Shelburne Lakers sale -- photo3 [576x324]
images.caption: The second sale of the Lakers put the team in significant transition again -- with new owners evaluating everything and squabbling former owners jostling for power and money. Iger and Kushner are Doncic's fifth team owners in the past three years.

article.headline: Suns and Nuggets meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Denver Nuggets (2-2, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (1-2, 11th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Suns and Nuggets meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Suns and Nuggets meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Denver Nuggets (2-2, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (1-2, 11th in the Western Conference) Phoenix; Friday, 10 p.m. EDT LINE: Nuggets -2.5; over/under is 233.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Denver Nuggets travel to play the Denver Nuggets in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. Phoenix went 45-37 overall, 29-23 in Western Conference play and 25-16 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Suns shot 45.5% from the field and 36.1% from 3-point range last season. Denver finished 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 6.8 steals, 4.0 blocks and 12.2 turnovers per game last season. INJURIES: Suns: Oso Ighodaro: day to day (oblique), Mark Williams: out (shoulder). Nuggets: Alpha Diallo: day to day (personal), Spencer Jones: day to day (hamstring), Cameron Johnson: day to day (ankle), Julian Strawther: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
